hook: TGSPDCL boss orders *every-15-day* reviews of Old City power circle
hook_b: TGSPDCL boss orders *every-15-day* reviews of Old City power circle
tldr: TGSPDCL CMD Jitesh V Patil visited the Sitarambagh sub-division on Nov 27 and announced fortnightly reviews of Hyderabad South Circle covering dues, maintenance and complaints.

beats.what: Patil reviewed the Mangalhat, Dattatreya Colony, Sitarambagh and Chudibazar sections under Begum Bazar Division, checking bill collection, maintenance and staff performance.
beats.why: He said negligence and corruption would not be tolerated and staff who fail to improve would face strict action.
beats.care: Old City residents may see a push on pending dues (the 'D-list'), meter shifting outside homes, and grievance resolution.

causes.label: Dues and service gaps in South Circle

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Employees must report for duty by 8.30 am daily, the CMD directed.

cards.q: How is power supply in your area lately?

qs: How will residents know whether grievance resolution improves after the reviews?
Who pays for shifting a meter from inside a house to outside?

facts.t: *4* sections reviewed: Mangalhat, Dattatreya Colony, Sitarambagh and Chudibazar.

steps.e: Shift meters from inside homes to outside
Review of targets, dues, maintenance, grievances

viz.verdict: Tighter monitoring of staff; residents may see dues follow-ups.

watch: Next review due in about two weeks; focus on dues recovery and consumer grievances.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: TGSPDCL MD calls for regular review of Hyderabad South Circle

fact: TGSPDCL will review Hyderabad South Circle's power service *every 15 days*
twist: Staff were told to move electricity meters from inside homes to outside premises faster.
